title: Mini metrics lab notebook - scratchpad
content:
Scratchpad: Mini metrics + run ledger
Owner: Raf (Rafael Kim) — quick personal tracker for small bench experiments, cost guesses, and TODOs. Mostly messy, for my brain.

Purpose:
- Fast reference when tuning batching/quantization for small models (7B/13B).
- Keep quick cost back-of-envelope for demos.
- Note anomalies to raise in infra sync.

Quick glossary (personal):
- q8: int8-ish quant profile used in local compile
- KB: KV cache warm; FW = cold
- p50/p95/p99: latency percentiles (ms) measured from client with streaming suppressed

Run ledger (CSV-ish) — columns: run_id,date,model,quant,GPU,batch,seq_len,kv_state,tokens_per_s,p50_ms,p99_ms,cost_per_1M_tokens_usd,notes
R001,2025-11-06,redwood-13b,q8,A100-80GB,1,128,cold,4200,48,210,7.8,odd p99 spikes every 30s
R002,2025-11-06,redwood-13b,q8,A100-80GB,4,128,warm,8200,62,340,4.2,throughput scales but p50 increases
R003,2025-11-12,redwood-7b,q4,H100-94GB,8,64,warm,15000,21,95,1.9,very smooth; try batching 12
R004,2025-12-01,redwood-13b,q16,H100-94GB,2,256,cold,3600,55,270,6.9,cold KV hurt; consider async prefetch
R005,2025-12-15,open-llama-13b,q8,A100-80GB,1,512,warm,2800,120,650,9.5,tokenization mismatch in prompt->reduce seq_len

Quick pivot notes:
- If KV cache warm and batch>1, tokens/s increases roughly linear until memory limit; watch p99 balloon.
- q4 on H100 seems promising for 7B: low latency + cheap. Confirm with 2 more seeds.

Micro cost model (very rough):
- A100-80GB: $3.6/hr (dev estimate), H100: $8.5/hr (on-demand).
- Compute tokens/sec => tokens/hr => cost per 1M tokens.
Example: R003 15k tokens/s => 54M tokens/hr => cost/hr 8.5 => cost per 1M tokens ~= 0.16 USD. (matches notes)

Open questions / TODOs:
- [ ] Re-run R003 x3 with different random seeds and pinned CPU cores (Jonah suggested weird variance).
- [ ] Try batch 12 on 7B q4 to see if p99 jumps; if no, consider moving some demo traffic to 7B.
- [ ] Confirm real infra pricing for Dedicated pools (talk to infra finance) — my $/hr numbers are placeholders.
- [ ] Add a short script to auto-calc cost_per_1M from csv output (python/dataframe quickie).

Short copy-paste checklist for ad-hoc runs:
1) Set model + quant in runtime config (use local dev build 2025-11-01).
2) Start a short 5-min warmup (KV prefill).
3) Run fixed prompt loop (10k tokens) collect p50/p95/p99 via caliper.
4) Save output to /tmp/bench-<runid>.json and paste run row into this doc.

Notes-to-self (brain-dump):
- Saw p99 spikes aligned with GC trace logs once — maybe Python GC on the parent process? Add gc.disable in dev harness.
- For demo next month: aim for 7b q4 on H100 if stable; fallback plan is 13b q8 on A100 with lower concurrency.
- Link checklist to PR: github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks/issues/98

Short log of conversations about this:
- 2025-11-07: Maya -> slack: "Try q4 for latency-sensitive demos" (noted).
- 2025-12-02: Jonah -> slack: "I saw batch=4 slow downs on A100; could be CUDA streams"

End of scratchpad. Keep this file small and editable. If something interesting repeats, push to shared_drives/engineering/observability/benchmarks (formalize).
